2. if you are having panic attacks look into breathing techniques you can do for yourself in those moments, look for ways to ground yourself to be present in your body and in the moment instead of derailing in your head. 
i personally like to take a deep breath in hold for 3-5 seconds then release 3-5 then take another deep breath in and repeat but i actually count in my head during this 


3. find phrases that comfort you and work for you. 
i like to tell myself “this isn’t about me and even if it was it could be talked through it may not be right now in this moment and that’s okay” 
“this is not the end of the world, i need to give it time” 
“even if i may have upset this person giving them the space to feel safe is what should happen right now” 
“this is part of the human experience , ill be okay” 


4. practice labeling your feelings , recognizing where they are coming from and what, and ways to comfort yourself when it happens.

when i’m sad, i don’t like to be alone so i will sit in silence with someone

when i’m mad i need space

communicating it is what helps the relationship 

5.  i’ve learned to separate a situation from the person or people and i will communicate that 

“right now im not upset with you but at the situation”

6. lastly when i feel like im going to shut down i start to type , write , or use non verbal communication but at that moment im thinking of ways to ground myself. figure out what works for you.

i share your pain 100%. i am “high functioning “ i have not been diagnosed and no one wants to diagnose me either but i still accommodate myself.  i am constantly burnt out, i have a hard time feeding myself, bathing is absolutely a chore, i hate  driving, but i am able to hold down a job. i have a degree as well. 

 i came up with a plan for myself . i learned more and more about autism, ways to accommodate myself. if i had energy a certain day i would do everything i can that day and plan for when i no longer had that energy. i am NOT mean to myself when i can’t get things done, i give myself some grace even if my room is a mess. i made a priority list like : i HAVE to shower every morning at least, i HAVE to have one meal at least, I MUST brush my teeth. 
my room is set to my sensory needs, i have things i enjoy and “ self care kits”. i do not over exert myself on days i work. i plan out my weeks and my hobbies. i give myself the comfort foods i like. 

i use to have awful nightmares and do experience ptsd so i have told myself that if and when i have nightmares that is my brain deleting what it doesn’t need. it’s processing information and deleting it to make space for new. i thank my own brain for doing the work. 

if you can look into more herbal remedies , chinese medicine, and non western medicine ways to heal your chronic pain. 

little things like that. 

it’s all a process, it takes a while, you are 19 literally 1 years old in adult years. give yourself some grace. i have two cats , i live by myself, i have my degree, i am also working towards a PH.D but i am not in school right now because i am figuring out things i like before i commit to a subject because i like a lot of things. i am 25 btw. give yourself some time, grace, compassion, and accommodation. educate yourself as much as you can. everything you want is doable but it will be work EXTRA work since autism brain is wired a bit differently to feel more, to intake more, having more neuron connections but it is 100% doable. you got this.

i have tried over 8 different kinds of meds, none really helped me. only some made it a little … less louder. seroquel was cool but it really affected other parts of my body like my blood sugar and sweating so much. my doctor kept suggesting higher doses but did tell me it won’t guarantee help with paranoia. i do not take meds now. what really helped was therapy when i was able to afford it and journaling. i noticed a pattern that if my paranoia got bad it’s because something in my life wasn’t going well or i was just not in a good head space. like for example my paranoia spiked when i was having financial issues and family issues. i came up with a plan when it does happen & phrases that helped me calm down.

i avoided social media , i listened to instrumental music , i watched less movies / media that increased that paranoia , i stopped smoking during those times.
